Subject: Performance SLO p95/p99 hosted vs current provider - postcall recap

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can qualify the p95/p99 end-to-end latency requirements and plan a technical deep-dive: 

Key notes from the call:
- Finlytics target: p95 end-to-end <= 350ms, p99 <= 800ms for typical inference requests (avg prompt ~250 tokens, avg completion ~60 tokens)
- Current provider observed: p95 ~900ms, p99 ~1.9-2.1s (sporadic spikes under load)
- Concurrency needs: steady-state concurrency ~75 requests, expected bursts up to 250 concurrent connections during trading windows
- Throughput: sustained ~500 req/s, peaks ~1.2k req/s for short windows
- Streaming: partial-token streaming required for chat UIs - target TTFB <150ms for initial token stream start

Action items / next steps:
1) Redwood to run a targeted perf verification plan against Finlytics' representative prompts and model config (we'll register the exact payloads). Attachment: finlytics-slo-matrix.csv includes the prompt sample set you shared.
2) Finlytics to provide two weeks of current provider traces / percentile snapshots (token-level if available) and a short list of peak hours for focused load tests.
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive (engineers + infra) to validate streaming behavior and to walk through sample traces.

Proposed timing: dev deep-dive on Fri 2027-07-02 10:00 PT (can move if needed).

I'll coordinate internally to prepare a test harness, representative payloads, and a short perf run that compares p95/p99 across our hosted API and your current provider.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Can we validate the following internally before the Fri deep-dive?

Laura / team -

Thanks for the notes. I'll own the lab run and coordinate with Infra to reserve a small dedicated pool so we don't hit noisy neighbors during the test. Proposed perf verification plan:

1) Smoke run (quick): 10m, 50 concurrent, sample prompts - collect p50/p95/p99 and CPU/GPU utilization.
2) Main comparison: 30m steady run @100 concurrency (approx their steady), then 15m burst ramp to 250 concurrently (10s ramp). We'll capture end-to-end timing including:
   - client->gateway (ingress)
   - gateway->worker scheduling latency
   - model first-token latency (TTFB)
   - final-token completion latency
   - token throughput (tokens/sec)

3) Streaming validation: instrument the streaming path to assert TTFB <150ms and median per-chunk time under 40ms for the first 5 chunks.

Artifacts we'll generate and upload:
- rdw-perf-sample-traces.zip (sample traces + ingestion scripts)
- a short slides summary with plots (p95/p99 charts)

I'll aim to have smoke run results by Thu EOD PST and main run artifacts ready before the Fri deep-dive. If Finlytics can run the same payloads against their provider and share traces ahead of the call that will make the comparison clean.

- Aditya
